title: Taiwanese Student Association at UC Irvine
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association (TSA) at the University of California, Irvine is a student organization listed among the recognized Asian American campus organizations by the UCI School of Humanities. The organization maintains a Facebook page (facebook.com/tsauci) and an Instagram account (@uci.tsa), though neither carries a formal mission statement or founding year in their public-facing content.

The TSA is distinct from TAO (Taiwanese American Organization) and TNO (Taiwan National Organization), both of which also operate at UCI. Based on the pattern common to TSA chapters at other UC campuses, this organization likely serves students with ties to Taiwan and those interested in Taiwanese culture, though no first-party source at UCI articulates this scope explicitly.
